tasks.purpose: 作为公众号封面，用一个清晰主体表现 AI 加速资料流动、人的判断仍处于工作中心。

final_stage.content_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: WeChat technology essay cover. Create a mature editorial visual about AI reorganizing work rather than replacing an entire job. Show one human researcher at a desk in three-quarter view. One hand sorts a small set of printed research papers and evidence cards; the other hand deliberately guides a luminous stream of document fragments, task nodes, and connecting lines into a new arrangement. The human is visibly attentive and in control, expressing judgment rather than passivity. Use a refined mixed-media editorial illustration with tactile paper-collage textures, subtle dimensional lighting, and a restrained ivory, charcoal, coral, and cobalt palette. Keep one strong central focal point and generous clean margins. The visual should feel like a sophisticated technology magazine cover, not a cartoon or corporate advertisement.
output_constraints: Very wide landscape composition suitable for a 2.35:1 WeChat cover crop
Keep the human, hands, papers, and main light flow inside the central 60% safe area so both wide and square crops remain meaningful
No title, captions, labels, UI copy, or other legible text
Readable as a small mobile thumbnail without relying on tiny details
avoid: Robots firing workers, layoffs scenes, sad office workers, replacement metaphors, giant brains, humanoid AI faces, or threatening machinery
Doodle style, childish line art, meme aesthetics, generic stock-photo polish, or decorative clutter
Patreon, Google, Gemini, Image2, or any third-party logos and trademarks
Logos, trademarks, watermarks, extra text, garbled text, fake interfaces, charts, or unverified claims

tasks.purpose: 保留首版正文涂鸦作为被用户否决的视觉迭代记录；该图不再进入正文。

final_stage.content_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: body illustration for a Chinese technology essay. Create a deliberately awkward hand-drawn editorial doodle on warm off-white textured paper, read clearly from left to right in three connected beats. First, a tiny friendly abstract AI helper rapidly searches and sorts a loose pile of paper sheets and evidence cards, with quick motion lines. Second, one ordinary human researcher at a messy desk checks the same material with a magnifying glass and red pencil, compares two evidence cards, and deliberately chooses one branch at a fork. Third, a manager quietly rearranges the same task cards around a small team board, changing who handles which pieces without erasing the people. Connect the beats with bold uneven arrows so the point is clear: some steps speed up, human judgment remains, and the work is reorganized. Use wobbly black ink outlines, intentionally clumsy proportions, sparse colored-pencil accents in cobalt blue, orange, red, and green, visible eraser marks and margin scribbles, handmade notebook-zine quality. Keep the mood witty and thoughtful rather than polished, cheerful, or dystopian. No photorealism.
output_constraints: Horizontal 16:9 composition with three visually distinct beats and all essential subjects inside the central 80% crop-safe area
No readable words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, or interface text inside the image
Simple high-contrast silhouettes and bold arrows that remain understandable at 375 px and 390 px phone width
avoid: Layoff scenes, firing gestures, people disappearing, sad workers carrying boxes, threatening robots, replacement metaphors, or claims that AI caused Patreon layoffs
Patreon, Google, Gemini, Image2, or any third-party logos and trademarks
Watermarks, readable text, garbled text, fake interfaces, charts, unverified statistics, real-person likenesses, photorealism, sleek corporate vector art, or glossy stock-image polish

tasks.purpose: 用一张正文涂鸦表现 Patreon 宣布裁减 93 人、团队少掉五分之一，但不暗示 AI 是裁员原因。

final_stage.content_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: frequent body illustration for a Chinese technology essay. 用户指定风格 Prompt：使用最大的色块、涂鸦感更重，尽可能弄得惨兮兮的。用白底，做得像是在老式电脑画图程序里拿鼠标画出来的。要隐约有点像，但又不太像，像是对上了又哪哪都不对，别扭得让人迷惑，呈现那种低清、一像素一像素蹭出来的感觉，突出它到底有多离谱地烂。算了，随便吧，你想怎么画就怎么画。 本图只画：一大团歪歪扭扭的人形色块挤在一个办公室方框里，一只普通人的手拿剪刀剪掉边缘一小撮人形纸片；旁边的电脑只是孤零零亮着，不与剪刀相连。 构图必须只有一个主要思想，尽量少画对象，使用最大、最笨、最不协调的纯色色块。
output_constraints: Horizontal 16:9 body illustration; one main idea only; largest possible flat color blocks
Pure white background with no paper texture, no shadow, no gradient, and no decorative environment
No readable words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, or interface text inside the image
Hard pixelated mouse-drawn edges, deliberately low-resolution appearance, and mobile-readable silhouettes
avoid: Polished editorial illustration, clean vector art, smooth curves, anti-aliased linework, pencil, crayon, watercolor, paper grain, collage, realistic lighting, 3D, photorealism, cinematic composition, cute professional cartoon style, or balanced graphic design
Logos, trademarks, watermarks, readable text, garbled text, fake interfaces, real-person likenesses, or verified-looking news scenes
Any visual claim that AI caused Patreon layoffs unless the causal arrow is visibly rejected
